# Positiva siffror från Truecaller – Ilija Batljan om fastighetssektorn

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-10-19  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon opened the Q3 reporting season with mixed signals. The main worry was 'AI-frossa': stress in the credit market around debt-heavy AI infrastructure names such as CoreWeave and Nscale, though several speakers still see the AI boom's fundamentals as intact. Truecaller rose about 6% after preliminary Q3 figures showing its ads business has passed the bottom, while Catena Media fell 18-19% on a profit warning and Teqnion slipped on negative organic growth. In a long interview, SBB founder and PPI investment chief Ilija Batljan said the Swedish property crisis is at or near the bottom, warned that AI will keep hurting office property, preferred residential and social-infrastructure property, and defended the PPI/SBB/Preservium deals and the role of Aker.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 TRUE-B — Truecaller | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Preliminary Q3 shows ads have passed the bottom; stock up ~6%; Indian tax dispute still pending.

#### Reasoning

CFO Odd Bohlin says the ads business has passed the bottom and the other two segments are developing well. More than 30% of revenue now comes from outside India. Management gives no guidance, and the Indian transfer-pricing case adds uncertainty. Host called it a flattening out rather than a turnaround. Positive momentum, but the recovery is not yet confirmed.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Indian transfer-pricing ruling is materially adverse
- if ad revenue growth reverses
- if Indian regulation hurts the business model

> *"Vi har passerat botten och börjar nu se en bättre marknad igen."*

---

### ⛔ CTM — Catena Media | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Another profit warning; AI search threatens the whole affiliate model; stock down 18-19%.

#### Reasoning

Hosts say there is hardly anything left after repeated profit warnings. If people search through AI, they never click the affiliate links that earn Catena commission, so the whole business model is threatened.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the company proves traffic is resilient to AI search

> *"Catena Media finns knappt någonting kvar där."*

---

### ⛔ TEQ — Teqnion | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Growth comes only from acquisitions; organic growth -3%; host doesn't rate it among serial acquirers.

#### Reasoning

Q3 growth was entirely acquisition-driven while organic growth stayed negative. Host says the company hasn't delivered in a long time, and the market sent the stock down ~4%.

#### Sell Triggers

- if organic growth turns positive

> *"Det är väl inte någon av de serieförvärv jag håller högt."*

---

### 🟠 CRWV — CoreWeave | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Stock has fallen hard; a speaker said buying at the bottom historically doubled money within a year, but the company is heavily indebted.

#### Reasoning

AI infrastructure demand remains huge and customers are creditworthy hyperscalers. Against that, high debt, rising rates and credit-market stress make the stock volatile. Contrarian and speculative.

#### Sell Triggers

- if credit spreads widen further
- if contract volumes are renegotiated
- if hyperscaler capex slows

> *"Köper du den på botten kan du dubbla pengarna inom ett år, historiskt."*

---

### 🟢 WALL-B — Wallenstam | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Kepler Cheuvreux upgraded to buy from hold, target 46 SEK (from 44).

#### Reasoning

Analyst opinion (Kepler), not the hosts'. A residential-focused landlord fits Batljan's preference for residential over offices. Still trades at a NAV discount.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rates rise again
- if residential transaction yields widen

> *"Kepler Chevreau höjde Wallenstam till köp från behåll."*

---

### ⛔ FABG — Fabege | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Jefferies cut target to 60 from 79; office-heavy, and Batljan expects offices to take more damage from AI.

#### Reasoning

Analyst target cut plus the guest's view that AI is an industrial revolution that will punish the office sector hard. Fabege is a Stockholm office landlord with a large NAV discount.

#### Sell Triggers

- if office vacancy improves
- if AI fears on office demand prove overblown

> *"Jag tror att kontorssektor kommer att få ytterligare väldigt mycket stryk."*

---

### ⛔ CORE-B — Corem | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Largest NAV discount in the sector; DNB Carnegie cut target to 2.40.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst cut and the deepest discount in the sector. Its offices are exposed to the structural AI headwind Batljan described.

#### Sell Triggers

- if refinancing risk eases
- if office demand recovers

> *"Störst rabatt har Corem, där DNB Carnegie nyligen sänkte riktkursen till 2,40 från 2,50."*

---

### 🟢 SAND — Sandvik | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Morgan Stanley upgraded to overweight from equal-weight; stock rising.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst upgrade. Hosts also expect currency tailwinds and strong order books for Swedish engineering this season.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Q3 orders disappoint
- if the engineering cycle weakens

> *"Morgan Stanley har höjt till övervikt från tidigare jämvikt."*

---

### 🟠 AXFO — Axfood | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Punished on many reports in a row and Coop is starting a price war, but hosts see it as a defensive pick if AI turbulence grows.

#### Reasoning

Host Peter wants to believe in Axfood as a safe grocery stock in a more turbulent, AI-driven market. Repeated report-day drops and the Coop price war are near-term risks heading into the report.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Coop price war compresses margins
- if the next report disappoints again

> *"Vi vill ändå tro på Axfood, särskilt om vi går in i en oroligare börsfas"*

---

### 🟠 META — Meta | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host's favourite report this week; expects reassuring figures amid AI worries.

#### Reasoning

Host expects Meta to calm AI worries, as ASML and TSMC did.

#### Sell Triggers

- if capex guidance spooks the market
- if ad revenue disappoints

> *"Mitt i AI-oron kommer vi att få, från Meta, säkert ganska betryggande siffror."*

---

### 🟠 GETI-B — Getinge | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Shaky on the market but gaining momentum; CEO reiterates the margin target.

#### Reasoning

Positive momentum and management sticking to its margin target ahead of the report.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the margin target is abandoned

> *"Getinge, de har haft det skakigt på börsen men börjar få momentum."*
